# Deyou Tape

> > Deyou Tape is a China-based manufacturer of aluminum foil tape and insulation products for HVAC, construction, and industrial applications with specialized adhesive and thermal protection solutions.

Deyou Tape specializes in manufacturing aluminum foil tapes with various adhesive systems (acrylic, rubber resin, solvent-based) and insulation facing materials (FSK, ASJ, PSK) for HVAC ductwork sealing, thermal insulation, EMI shielding, and industrial applications. The company offers customizable tape solutions with flame-retardant and temperature-resistant properties for construction and refrigeration industries.

## Key Topics

- Aluminum foil tape
- HVAC insulation
- Acrylic adhesive
- FSK tape
- Thermal insulation
- Flame-retardant
- Duct sealing
- EMI shielding
- Rubber resin tape
- Glass cloth reinforced
- Temperature resistance
- Industrial applications
- Moisture resistance
- PET foil tape
- Double-sided adhesive

## Core Products

- [Aluminum Foil Tapes](https://www.dydeyou.com/aluminum-foil-tape): Main aluminum foil tape product line with HVAC solutions and customization options
- [HVAC Insulation Tape](https://www.dydeyou.com/hvac-insulation-tape): HVAC insulation tape including FSK and ASJ tape for duct sealing and thermal protection
- [Solvent-Based Aluminum Acrylic Tape](https://www.dydeyou.com/solvent-based-aluminum-acrylic-tape): Solvent acrylic aluminum tape for HVAC with superior temperature resistance
- [Acrylic Adhesive Aluminum Foil Tape](https://www.dydeyou.com/acrylic-adhesive-aluminum-foil-tape): Acrylic adhesive aluminum foil tape for HVAC and industrial applications
- [Aluminum Foil Rubber Resin Tape](https://www.dydeyou.com/aluminum-foil-rubber-resin-tape): Rubber resin aluminum foil tape for HVAC sealing and ductwork repair
- [Aluminum Foil Glass Cloth Tape](https://www.dydeyou.com/aluminum-foil-glass-cloth): Aluminum foil glass cloth tape with high strength and flame retardancy
- [Self-Wound Aluminum Foil Tape](https://www.dydeyou.com/self-wound-aluminum-foil-tape): Self-wound linerless aluminum foil tape for HVAC and industrial use
- [Colored Aluminum Foil Tape](https://www.dydeyou.com/colored-aluminum-foil-tape): Colored aluminum foil tape in multiple colors with heat and flame resistance

## Specialized Tape Solutions

- [Aluminum Foil Shielding Tape](https://www.dydeyou.com/aluminum-foil-shielding-tape): Aluminum foil shielding tape for EMI protection and cable wrapping
- [PET Foil Tape](https://www.dydeyou.com/pet-foil-tape): PET foil tape for EMI shielding and thermal insulation in electronics
- [Double-Sided Adhesive Tape](https://www.dydeyou.com/double-sided-adhesive-tape): Double-sided adhesive tape for mounting, bonding, and assembly applications
- [Laminated Insulation Facing](https://www.dydeyou.com/laminated-insulation-facing): Laminated insulation facing including FSK, PSK, and ASJ for thermal protection
- [Reflective Aluminum Foil Insulation](https://www.dydeyou.com/reflective-aluminum-foil-insulation): Reflective aluminum foil insulation for energy efficiency and thermal performance

- [General Construction Tape](https://www.dydeyou.com/application/general-construction): Construction tape applications for duct sealing and air sealing solutions
- [Reinforced Aluminum Foil Tape](https://www.dydeyou.com/application/reinforce-aluminum-foil-tape): Reinforced aluminum foil tape applications with FSK and ASJ options
- [Fire-Resistant Tape](https://www.dydeyou.com/application/fire-resistant-tape): Fire-resistant tape applications for HVAC, wiring, and construction
- [Refrigeration Aluminum Polyester Tape](https://www.dydeyou.com/application/refrigeration-aluminum-foil-tape): Aluminum polyester tape for refrigeration and white goods manufacturing
